QuestInfo.name: Standing Silent
QuestInfo.0: Together with your fellow knights, you have exterminated the moles. A visitor has arrived.
QuestInfo.1:
The knight says there's someone to see you from the palace. Could it be...?
Head to the meeting place.
If you see any #b#o8230075:##k on the way, you might as well exterminate them as well.
QuestInfo.2:
You remembered your days with the prince. 
He believes the king has gone mad, and must step down. He said that if he tried to make that happen, he would "either die or become the new king."
Being bound, as a knight, to protect Sharenian forever, you're unsure of where your loyalties should lie -- to your king, or to your prince and beloved student?
